theorem_title: Encoding cost bound from the binomial entropy certificate
formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSumSharpTail.encoding_bound (c m : ℕ) (hc : 10 < c) (hm : 1 ≤ m) :
    (10 : ℝ) ^ (c * m) / Real.sqrt (ThreeSumSharpTail.boxCount c m 0 : ℝ) ≤
      Real.sqrt (c * m + 1 : ℝ) * (4 ^ m : ℝ) ^ ThreeSumSharpTail.encodingExponent c := by sorry
natural_language_statement: For every integer c>10 and m>=1, the encoding factor 10^(cm)/sqrt(M) is at most sqrt(cm+1) times (4^m)^A(c), where M is the exact baseline box count choose(cm,m)*9^(cm-m). This is the pointwise encoding inequality used to show eventual tile fit and absorb preprocessing overheads. The proof uses the lower binomial entropy bound and exact exponential algebra; it makes no program-runtime conclusion by itself.
